title: Removal surgeries attended; some implants looked like human microchips
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Removal surgeries attended; some implants looked like human microchips, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I attend I attended the last three removal surgeries including my own.

plain: A man named Steve Coburn told podcast host Jesse Michels that he went to the last three surgeries held to remove objects people believe were implanted in their bodies, and one of them was his own. He credits a man named Roger Leer, and he says some of the implants looked like microchips made by people. If true, it would suggest that someone, maybe human, is putting devices inside people.
